name: Fleming Island
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Fleming Island, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Fleming Island, FL: the Whoville light parade, Whitey's Christmas Boat Parade and Santa at the Fleming Island Library.
lede: Fleming Island celebrates with a Whoville light parade in Eagle Harbor, a lighted boat parade on the water and Santa at the branch library.
celebrates: Fleming Island's Christmas has a neighborhood feel and a waterfront one. Eagle Harbor, a master planned community, holds its Whoville light parade and tree lighting with Santa photos on a December evening. Whitey's Fish Camp, on County Road 220, hosts a Christmas Boat Parade with lighted boats, which Explore Clay files under Christmas, family friendly and outdoor events. The Fleming Island Library, part of the Clay County Public Library System, brings Santa in for crafts, wishes and photos for all ages, with a children's activity room and a teen zone at the branch.
lastyear: Eagle Harbor held its Whobilation light parade and tree lighting in December 2025, according to the flyer on its events page, and its community magazine described a whimsical light parade down Eagle Harbor Parkway with festive floats and Whos of all ages. This year the community uses the name Whoville for its Holiday Light Parade and keeps the same format of a parade, a tree lighting and Santa photos.
facts: Eagle Harbor describes the evening as a light parade, a tree lighting and Santa photos, and its events page also lists a Red, White and Blue Parade and a Scream'n Eagles event. Whitey's Fish Camp is at 2032 County Road 220, and the fish camp's own website is whiteysfishcamp.com. The Fleming Island Library's phone number is 904-278-3720, and its Santa visit is listed for the Children's Activity Room, the General area and the Teen Zone, so it works for a wide range of ages.
trains: Fleming Island's 2026 listings do not include a train ride. The closest railroad museum entry on our site is the Jacksonville terminal page, and our Jacksonville guide covers more train and light events in the city. Families who want a ride on the water instead can watch the lighted boats at Whitey's Fish Camp on parade night, and the fish camp's listing says more details are still to come.
train_links: The closest train museum page on our site, in Jacksonville.

faq: When does Fleming Island hold its Christmas parades?
The 2026 listings show the Whoville light parade in Eagle Harbor on a December Sunday evening and Whitey's lighted boat parade on a December Saturday evening.

Yes. Eagle Harbor lists Santa photos after the tree lighting, and the Fleming Island Library lists Santa for photos and crafts.
